```python
def flatten(nested: list) -> list:
    """Return a flat list of all non-list elements from nested, left-to-right."""
    result = []
    for item in nested:
        if isinstance(item, list):
            result.extend(flatten(item))  # recurse on nested list
        else:
            result.append(item)           # keep non-list as single element
    return result
```
